name: numra/numra-php
description: Numra PHP client — cash-on-delivery risk checks, outcome reporting and webhook verification for Morocco.

numra.version-note: There is deliberately no `version` field. Packagist takes the version from the git tag and `composer validate --strict` rejects a declared one, so carrying it here fails CI before it reaches the registry. The only thing that ever needed a real version was the path repository in numra-laravel, and that is gone. The release workflow already refuses a tag that disagrees with Numra::VERSION, which is the check that actually matters.
